answer: An operator copying one text across 116 aliases thus burns for 116 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. Since the kernel hash is stored at intake, the nadir graph groups the endorsements and the vertex audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 5 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
